# Spatialdata

## Stage control

| Field | Type | Default | Level | Description | Advice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | `Literal['plan', 'build']` | `plan` | `basic` | Run read-only discovery/planning or also create a new Zarr store. | Keep plan until the selected assets and planner diagnostics have been reviewed. |

## Discovery

| Field | Type | Default | Level | Description | Advice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `root` | `str` | `.` | `basic` | Project-relative root searched for likely spatial assets. | - |
| `discover_unlisted_assets` | `bool` | `True` | `basic` | Search for additional likely assets beyond explicitly configured paths. | - |
| `include_discovered_image_panels` | `bool` | `True` | `advanced` | Include high-confidence unquantified ROI image panels in the proposed spec. | - |
| `include_discovered_histology` | `bool` | `True` | `advanced` | Include high-confidence RGB/RGBA ROI collections in the proposed spec. | - |
| `include_discovered_maxfuse` | `bool` | `True` | `advanced` | Include high-confidence matched transcriptome AnnData candidates. | - |

## Output

| Field | Type | Default | Level | Description | Advice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `output_path` | `str` | `spatialdata.zarr` | `basic` | Project-relative destination for a newly built SpatialData Zarr. | Existing paths are never overwritten. |
| `attrs` | `Dict[str, Any]` | `{}` | `advanced` | Small project-level attributes to place on the SpatialData object. | - |

## Primary assets

| Field | Type | Default | Level | Description | Advice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `anndata_path` | `Optional[str]` | `null` | `basic` | Explicit primary quantified IMC AnnData; null allows conservative discovery. | - |
| `cell_masks_folder` | `Optional[str]` | `null` | `basic` | Explicit folder containing one integer cell mask per ROI. | - |
| `primary_images_folder` | `Optional[str]` | `null` | `basic` | Explicit folder containing one channel-image subfolder per ROI. | - |

## Memory

| Field | Type | Default | Level | Description | Advice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `copy_adata` | `bool` | `False` | `advanced` | Copy the primary AnnData before SpatialData table annotation. | False avoids a second large in-memory copy while leaving the source H5AD unchanged. |
